preconditions.description: The length of the first bracket sequence s is no more than 200 characters.
The length of the second bracket sequence t is no more than 200 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The first bracket sequence s consists only of characters '(' and ')'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in t)
preconditions.description: The second bracket sequence t consists only of characters '(' and ')'.

postconditions.description: The length of the output bracket sequence result is no more than 400 characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in result)
postconditions.description: The output bracket sequence result consists only of characters '(' and ')'.
The output bracket sequence result is a regular bracket sequence.

postconditions.expression: s in result and t in result
postconditions.description: The output bracket sequence result contains both given bracket sequences s and t as subsequences.
